grounding.single_tie_point: NT1 net tie placed at J12 (ESC lead) pin 3. It is the ONLY connection between the logic battery's ground and the propulsion side. Reason: the ESC / servo PWM signals need a common reference (firmware/README.md:247, 323; firmware/atmega128_fc/src/board.h:84, 91, 107 'common ground')
rules: J18 (power sense) has NO ground pin: the dividers return to logic GND and see the bus negative through NT1
servo return currents flow J8-J11 pin 3 -> GND_PWR -> J12 pin 3, never through the logic GND
with the ESC lead unplugged the logic ground floats from the propulsion side - bench-safe

layout_rules.note: lessons of the rev-1 review (rev-1 independent review 2026-11-05) - the placement / routing steps must meet them and check them with scripts (reuse scratchpad/pcb/review_*/ checks)
rules: decoupling: every MCU / ESP VCC 100 nF pad <= 3 mm path to its pin, same layer, own GND via; pre-route and LOCK before Freerouting; scripted check of the cap-pad-to-pin routed length
crystals: Y + 2 x 27 pF <= 3 mm from XTAL1 / XTAL2, hand-routed on F.Cu, no vias, locked, solid GND under, >= 1 mm from the board edge

silkscreen on F.SilkS next to every off-board connector: servo 'S + -' + function, ESC, logic battery '+ - 1S', 6S sense pin names + 'NO GND', GPS pins, power switch, arm, buzzer, ISP name + pin-1, ESP flash header pin names + '3V3 ONLY', reset-hold names; refdes where they fit

GND: In1.Cu is a solid GND plane without tracks, B.Cu carries signals + a GND fill, stitching vias (none in the antenna keep-out), no thin GND tracks, nlink SPI over unbroken GND, GND_PWR trunk along the board edge
servo power: SERVO_5V / GND_PWR >= 1.5 mm wide or poured, no neck-downs, more than one via per layer change

boost path (spec/rev3_plan.json routing_notes): VBAT_LOGIC_RAW / VBAT_LOGIC / VBAT_LOGIC_SW from J14 through Q10 and J15 to L5 as a pour or >= 2.0 mm wide (target <= 0.035 Ohm, about 1.75 A average at the 3.0 V peak, E); BOOST_SW on F.Cu only, no via, as short as the two pads allow; +5V from the C57 / C43 pads into In2 with >= 3 vias; U8 pin 4 and the capacitor grounds into In1 with >= 3 vias, In1 solid under the block; BOOST_FB sensed at the output capacitor, away from BOOST_SW / L5; no signal trace under L5 on F.Cu
ESP-12F: VCC caps at pin 8; antenna keep-out free of copper on all four layers and of parts; the 1k series resistor next to the ESP RXD0 pin
DRC: 0 errors, hole-to-hole warnings 0; schematic parity

mechanical (MF-1..MF-9): OpenLog flat with its outline reserved; mated-plug outlines (JR servo 14.5 x 7.8 x 3.3, Dupont 14.0, JST / SPOX plugs, A) checked against the spigot bore r 57.0 and the joint screws in a script; ESC plug >= 2.0 mm from the motor-lead bullet zone; logic-battery connector with bend room; THT leads <= 1.5 mm under the board; module supports (GY-521 cantilever)
